findings.title: Await the asynchronous reschedule cleanup callbacks
findings.body: `forEach` discards the promises returned by this now-async callback. If `getCalendar()` rejects, including when constructing `CalendarService` throws, the failure no longer reaches the surrounding `try/catch` as it did when `getCalendar()` was synchronous. Instead, it becomes an unhandled rejection while the rescheduler can continue sending the email and reporting success despite failed cleanup. Await the promises from `bookingRefsFiltered.map(...)` inside the `try`. The same async-callback conversion in `packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts:125` and `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings.tsx:553` also needs its returned promises observed.
